context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar module fully functional. Route is /school/:subdomain/calendario. 6 event types: academic, institutional, administrative, holiday, special, communication. Admin roles (owner/admin/director) can create/edit/delete events. Visibility can be set by roles (teacher/student/parent) and grades. Events with empty visibility are visible to all users.
